body.value: 藩制一覧表 第七（須坂）（はんせいいちらんひょう だいしち・すざか）

Running header in the outer right margin: Han-sei ichiran-hyo (Survey of Domain Systems), Fascicle 7 (Suzaka). Provenance, not data. Suzaka's fascicle-7 entry closed on the preceding page-side, lower_p120_left, which ends on 人口四拾四人 / 神社貳十九社 / 知事家族九人 / 舩ナシ, so the header carries over onto a leaf whose body was left blank at the end of the fascicle.
柱題藩制一覽表第七（須坂）

Printed book-page number in the outer margin below the running header: 218. Pagination runs continuously across the fascicle break in this volume: lower_p120_right is 216, lower_p120_left 217, this leaf 218, and the facing lower_p121_left 219, where fascicle 8 opens with the maru-marker of Izuhara (Tsushima).
